description: This file provides utility functions for normalizing media attachment paths, resolving attachment types (image, audio, video, document), and checking attachment kinds within a media understanding module.

methods.name: normalizeAttachmentPath
methods.description: Normalizes a raw attachment path string, converting file URLs to local paths and validating Windows network paths.

methods.name: normalizeAttachments
methods.description: Generates an array of MediaAttachment objects from the context, resolving paths, URLs, and MIME types.

methods.name: resolveAttachmentKind
methods.description: Determines the media type (image, audio, video, document, unknown) based on MIME type and file extension.

methods.name: isVideoAttachment
methods.description: Checks if a media attachment is a video.

methods.name: isAudioAttachment
methods.description: Checks if a media attachment is audio.

methods.name: isImageAttachment
methods.description: Checks if a media attachment is an image.
